nodes.id: docs_上位机通讯寄存器说明书v50_v50protocol
nodes.label: V5.0 Protocol
nodes.source_file: docs/上位机通讯寄存器说明书V5.0.md
nodes.description: Complete register map for VPLC516E controller. IEEE(0-32) write area, IEEE(280-332) echo area, LONG(34/36/38/40/42/44/46) status registers. Defines T0/T1 channels, function state bit masks, and Func parameter definitions.

nodes.id: docs_上位机通讯寄存器说明书v50_threegatemechanism
nodes.label: Three-Gate Safety Mechanism
nodes.source_file: docs/上位机通讯寄存器说明书V5.0.md
nodes.description: Three-stage safety verification: Gate 1 pre-send check (IEEE write area), Gate 2 echo comparison (IEEE echo area), Gate 3 pre-trigger recheck (re-verify echo before FUNC triggers). Prevents stale or corrupted commands from reaching the controller.

nodes.description: Function 104 for emergency stop and system reset. Parameters defined in IEEE registers. Critical safety function.
